verdict.rationale: No first-party doc in the pack describes channel threading or named topics; the docs only confirm channels and channel messages exist (ms-teams-docs-11, ms-teams-docs-35). Community reports imply channel conversations are threaded: one user contrasts channels with DMs that have 'no threading' (ms-teams-comm-9), and others describe following threads (ms-teams-comm-12, ms-teams-comm-17). Those same users call the threading hard to follow, say channel notifications are easy to miss, and one says the threading 'truly beggars belief', which weakens the 'catch up efficiently' outcome. missing for 10: first-party documentation of channel threads/reply structure, named topic or subject support, catch-up features for busy channels (e.g., unread or thread summaries), positive hands-on corroboration that threading aids catch-up.
